from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    labels: dict[str, str]
    counters: dict[str, int] | None = None
    free: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    closed: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    patterned: dict[str, float] | None = None
    bare: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    nested_map: dict[str, dict[str, bool]] | None = None
    list_map: dict[str, list[str]] | None = None
    with_props: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            labels=data.get("labels"),
            counters=data.get("counters"),
            free=data.get("free"),
            closed=data.get("closed"),
            patterned=data.get("patterned"),
            bare=data.get("bare"),
            nested_map=data.get("nestedMap"),
            list_map=data.get("listMap"),
            with_props=data.get("withProps"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "labels": self.labels,
            "counters": self.counters,
            "free": self.free,
            "closed": self.closed,
            "patterned": self.patterned,
            "bare": self.bare,
            "nestedMap": self.nested_map,
            "listMap": self.list_map,
            "withProps": self.with_props,
        }
